$comment: #NEW-18 (FEED-102 ask 3, owner 2026-11-14) THE DUPLICATE-START WARNING (lib/sessions/issue-overlap.ts, send.ts sendSession; server only: the hub knows no issues, so eagent-hub-core does not replay this file). A send naming `issueIds` (a root's or a child's start, a forward into a session) NEVER fails over it: the result gains `warning` (joined with the send's other warnings by a space). `overlapWarning(issues)` = per named issue, in input order, each once: `done` (its status is done, cancelled or duplicate) → copy.done; else live HOLDERS = sessions not ended holding it (session_issues) OUTSIDE the tree the send lands in (a child of the same tree working on its root's issue is the normal case): the holders the caller may see (shared, or theirs) → copy.held with their ids (oldest first, comma-joined); none visible but some private to another member → copy.heldPrivate (ANONYMOUS: never an id, a title or a name); no holder → nothing. The lines join with a space; nothing = null (no warning). `cases` replay overlapWarning comparing the whole value.

copy.done: #{issue} is already done; check before working on it again.
copy.held: #{issue} already has a live session: {ids}. Coordinate with it before doing the same work.
copy.heldPrivate: Another member's private session works on #{issue}.

cases.name: an open issue nobody else holds: no warning
a done issue
cases.expected: #MA-1 is already done; check before working on it again.

cases.name: done wins over live holders
cases.expected: #MA-1 is already done; check before working on it again.

cases.name: visible holders are named, private ones are not
cases.expected: #MA-2 already has a live session: s1, s3. Coordinate with it before doing the same work.

cases.name: only private holders: anonymous
cases.expected: Another member's private session works on #MA-3.

cases.name: several issues in input order, a repeat once
cases.expected: Another member's private session works on #MA-3. #MA-1 is already done; check before working on it again.
